# Z-ERP by Z Systems

> Z-ERP (ZS-ERP) is a multi-branch ERP and point-of-sale (POS) system by Z Systems for Software Solutions (Port Said, Egypt). It combines cloud synchronization with an offline-capable local edition, cashier anti-theft permission controls, multi-warehouse inventory, accounting, and tax-compliant invoicing for businesses in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the Gulf (EGP, SAR, AED, QAR, KWD, BHD, OMR).

Z Systems builds ERP, retail management, and industry platforms for high-traffic retail, wholesale, supermarkets, restaurants, fitness centers, and construction companies. Z-ERP serves retail (fashion, electronics, perfumes, optical, cosmetics), food and beverage (restaurants, cafes, bakeries, roasteries), groceries (supermarkets, minimarts, butcheries), and wholesalers (automotive parts, building materials, hardware, distribution). Key capabilities: real-time multi-branch and multi-warehouse synchronization; an offline queue that keeps issuing invoices during internet outages and syncs when the connection returns; permission controls over price changes, receipt deletions, discounts, and cash-drawer openings with a tamper-evident audit log; stock alerts, batch and serial tracking, reorder thresholds, and inter-branch transfers; tax-field invoices with QR codes, VAT calculation, and a ZATCA submission service for Saudi Arabia (verify your local authority requirements before relying on it for filings); support for barcode scanners, thermal receipt printers, electronic scales, customer displays, and cash drawers.

## Sector and solution pages

- [Supermarket POS software](https://zsystemai.com/pos-supermarket): Z-ERP point of sale for supermarkets and grocery stores, with fast barcode checkout, stock that updates with every sale, cashier anti-theft controls, and an offline-capable local edition.
- [Restaurant and café POS software](https://zsystemai.com/pos-restaurants): Z-ERP point of sale for restaurants, cafés, and bakeries, covering dine-in, takeaway, and delivery orders, tax invoices with QR codes, and a ZATCA e-invoicing submission service for Saudi Arabia.
- [Offline POS software](https://zsystemai.com/offline-pos): The Z-ERP local edition that keeps selling, invoicing, and updating stock without internet and syncs automatically when the connection returns.
